title: Graded linear categories and graded linear functors from dg categories
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring. A $\mathbf Z$-graded $R$-linear category on an object set $O$ consists of an $R$-module $\mathcal D(x,y)^n$ for every $x,y\in O$ and $n\in\mathbf Z$, units $1_x\in\mathcal D(x,x)^0$, and $R$-bilinear composition $\mathcal D(y,z)^p\times\mathcal D(x,y)^q\to\mathcal D(x,z)^{p+q}$, satisfying the two unit laws and associativity. No differential is part of this structure. For a small $R$-linear cochain dg category $\mathcal C$ as in [lem-coef-dgcat-free-cell-calculus], a graded $R$-linear functor $\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$ is an object function $F$ and degree-preserving $R$-linear maps $\mathcal C(x,y)^n\to\mathcal D(Fx,Fy)^n$, preserving units and composition. It need not commute with the differential of $\mathcal C$. Object and morphism universes of $\mathcal D$ are independent.
